title: Wire dependency graph analysis into monitor-codebase Step 4.7
prompt:
Add Step 4.7 to monitor-codebase run.sh that runs dependency graph analysis.

Insert after Step 4.6 (duplication), before Step 5 (autofix).

Call: python3 "$SKILL_DIR/dep_graph.py" with scan_dirs as args,
capture JSON output to $ARTIFACTS_DIR/${project_name}_deps.json.

Include circular dependency count in Step 9 aggregate report.
If circular deps found, add them to the dogpile research query in Step 8.
